results.title: From Super Eagles To Super Falcons: Nigeria’s World Cup Nightmare Gets Worse
results.description: Nigeria’s Super Falcons have failed to qualify for the Women’s World Cup for the first time since the tournament began in 1991. South Africa defeated Nigeria 2-1 in a dramatic WAFCON play-off in Casablanca to end the Falcons’ nine-tournament World Cup streak.
